Strategy: Switch by item size: small items use Best Fit while large items take the roomiest bin, with exact fits always winning. Large items are hard to place later so roomy bins suit them, but the forty threshold is a guess and large items may still waste tight bins.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else ((r - item) if item >= 40 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
